rules.reason: Backed may not offer, sell or deliver xStocks to US persons, and they may only be transferred to non-US persons.

You can buy xStocks on the secondary market, but issuance and redemption through Backed are limited to professional investors: a Swiss FinSA Professional Client who is also an EU Qualified Investor if in the EU, or the local equivalent elsewhere. A typical retail holder cannot redeem.
Legally a tracker certificate under Swiss law, collateralised by the share. It is not the share itself.
